instruction.text: Read the chapter, then answer the reading comprehension questions.

atoms.text: Jake and Norbert were assigned to rubbish duty. Every day after school for the next two weeks they were responsible for clearing all the rubbish from the classrooms and hallways. It usually took them about an hour, so they always missed the bus. The first day, they didn’t talk at all. In fact, it’s quite possible they managed to not even look at each other. Both boys still seemed angry and blamed each other for their rubbish responsibilities. The next few days followed in the same way.

On the fourth day, Norbert found the music room unlocked. He tentatively walked in and the automatic lights switched on, illuminating all the instruments. Normally, Mr Bags had very serious rules about how and when to touch the instruments, but he was currently not there. Norbert walked over to the snare drum, picked up the drumsticks, and drummed like he had never been allowed to. The drum sounded incredibly loud, which made Norbert nervous that someone would hear, and he’d get in trouble again. The door handle jangled, and he threw down the sticks like they were on fire. Then, Jake walked in.

“Oh cool!” said Jake. He immediately ran over to the piano and started banging on random keys. Norbert started banging on the snare again. The room was louder with the two of them playing than it was when the whole class had music hour.

“Hey, Norbert, try to keep this rhythm,” yelled Jake over the drums, and with his hands made a pattern: clap clap snap clap. Norbert switched to the bongos and started trying to keep the rhythm. Jake went to another drum and started doing his own rhythm. They tried to keep their own rhythms, but it was much harder than it seemed. The rhythm finally seemed to improve, and they managed playing several times through without making a mistake. Then, right in the middle of everything, Jake caused a sound of a different kind. He farted. This was the most hilarious thing that had happened to either of them, and they laughed and laughed until they were both rolling on the floor.

atoms.a: What kind of narration does this chapter use?

b: They must write essays about how proper young men behave.
They have to redo the year five.
++They must clear the rubbish from the school for the next two weeks.

atoms.a: What did Norbert find that was surprising?
b: ++He found the door to the music room unlocked.
He found his shoes from last year.

atoms.a: What does Jake think of Norbert’s discovery?
b: ++He thinks it’s really cool and joins Norbert.
He thinks Norbert should close the room again.

atoms.a: What made both the boys laugh so hard?
